text:
Carmen: Quick thread to pin down MVP "surgical parachute" cuts. Proposal: remove Tenant Admin and Full Insights to v1; keep onboarding, SSO, prompt-store, embeddings export (batch), and a single search/recall UI in MVP. Also: a lightweight "counts" widget for pilots.

Ibrahim: +1. We need explicit rollback and a runtime toggle for the cache feature. If embcache isn't green, ship without it and enable later.

Sanjay: Infra reality check: full embcache = multi-week effort. Options:
- NO_CACHE (fastest)
- PREFIX_CACHE (tenant prefixes only) ~2d eng + 1d SRE
- SAMPLED_CANARY (50%) ~3w
If prefix cache accepted, add flag `mvp.runtime.embcache` default=false.

Liz: UX: counts tile + an "export pending" modal for batch exports. Will ship copy and wireframe tomorrow. Counts tile reduces pilot confusion.

Carmen: Proposed guardrails:
```
- mvp.latency_guard = true    # soft throttle on long requests
- mvp.cost_cap = 750         # soft alert threshold
- pilot_gate = 3 tenants on-boarded + search P95 <= 400ms (soft)
```

Ibrahim: Also add synthetic probes every 10m for tail latency and a burnline alert. Ops needs a one-click rollback: flip flag -> auto-throttle -> notify.

Sanjay: I'll scope PREFIX_CACHE by EOD. If missed, fallback to NO_CACHE and we enable probes. I'll deprioritize noncritical autoshard to free cycles.

ops-bot: Reminder: run `/freeze mvp-parachute` before Tue 09:00 to lock merges.

Carmen: Action items: Carmen -> publish cutboard; Ibrahim -> flag QA + rollback play; Sanjay -> prefix cache estimate; Liz -> counts tile + support copy. If no objections by Friday EOD I'll mark scope frozen. :eyes:
